spans.s: Arjunāvana (ā for a m.c.), n. of a locality (pertaining to Arjuna 2, above): Māy 〔23〕.
ārjanā (to ārjayati), winning, acquisition: Bbh 〔35.9〕 (prose) bhogānām ārjanā.

ārjayati, wins: LV 〔203.7〕 (vs) puṇyam ārjayāmo (meter requires short penult; ˚yamo? all mss. ārj˚) bahuṃ. Cf. ārjanā, supporting ā (preverb); BR 〔5.1043〕 cite samārjita (sam-ā-arj-) once from Mbh 〔13.5551〕.
Ārjava, n. of a cakravartin: Mv 〔i.154.1〕.
